n60665b6cf2a.s:
Which of the following were drivers of India's Look East Policy?
1. Countering China's influence
2. Access to new markets
3. Instability in West and Central Asia
Which of the above is/are correct?
n60665b6cf2a.x: All three - countering China, seeking new markets and instability in West and Central Asia - were drivers of the Look East Policy.

na19ebf2a97f.s: India's Link West (Think West) policy mainly focuses on:
o: Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific Islands
na19ebf2a97f.x: Link West, also called Think West, focuses on the Gulf, Iran and Israel.

n27d801e5d7e.s: SHANTI, India's normative framework for shared maritime spaces, is to be operationalised first in the:
n27d801e5d7e.x: SHANTI is a normative framework for shared maritime spaces to be operationalised first in the Bay of Bengal.

n95c998d4439.s: PM Modi set out India's free, open and inclusive Indo-Pacific vision at the Shangri-La Dialogue in:
n95c998d4439.x: Prime Minister Modi set out this vision, with ASEAN centrality, in his Shangri-La Dialogue keynote in June 2018.

n44fd6edb678.s: The Gujral Doctrine, one of the roots of Neighbourhood First, emphasised:
n44fd6edb678.x: The Gujral Doctrine emphasised non-reciprocity, non-interference and not allowing a country's territory to be used against a neighbour.

n10efe5a8da8.s: Under the SAGAR doctrine, India projects itself in the Indian Ocean Region as a:
o: Junior partner of an external power
n10efe5a8da8.x: SAGAR presents India as a net security provider in the Indian Ocean Region, partly in response to China's String of Pearls.

nf0131ab79ff.s:
Which of the following are ASEAN-linked connectivity projects?
1. Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project
2. India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway
3. Akhaura-Agartala railway link
nf0131ab79ff.x: Kaladan and the Trilateral Highway are ASEAN-linked projects; the Akhaura-Agartala rail link is associated with Bangladesh.

n442019f78ea.s: The launch of Neighbourhood First in May 2014 was symbolised by inviting the leaders of ____ to the PM's swearing-in.
n442019f78ea.x: SAARC leaders were invited to the May 2014 swearing-in; BIMSTEC leaders were invited in 2019.

ncab89fdc594.s: In August 2026, India-Uzbekistan ties were raised to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with a bilateral trade target of:
ncab89fdc594.x: The August 2026 upgrade set a $5 billion trade target by 2030, along with a uranium-supply framework.

n8db5e4b7cbb.s: The Shangri-La Dialogue, held in Singapore since 2002, is organised by:
n8db5e4b7cbb.x: The Shangri-La Dialogue is run by the London-based IISS and has been held in Singapore since 2002.

n83b366af7d7.s: Kovvada, the proposed site for Westinghouse AP1000 reactors, is in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
n83b366af7d7.x: Kovvada is in Srikakulam district and is the proposed site for the Westinghouse AP1000 reactors under India-US nuclear cooperation.

n6a3f52e0cb7.s: Which development is regarded as the turning point in India-US relations?
n6a3f52e0cb7.x: The 2008 India-US civil nuclear deal is regarded as the turning point in the relationship.

n3b3dceaf8b1.s: In the India-US context, CAATSA (2017) is mainly about US sanctions on countries that:
n3b3dceaf8b1.x: CAATSA provides for US sanctions against buyers of Russian arms; India sought a waiver over its S-400 purchase.

nf2df1bf3b6e.s: STA-1 status, granted by the US to India in 2018, gives India:
o: Access only to civilian nuclear technology
Licence-free access to a wide range of US military and dual-use technology
A veto over US defence exports to third countries
nf2df1bf3b6e.x: STA-1 allows faster, licence-free access to a wide range of US military and dual-use technology, comparable to NATO allies, without NATO membership.

n68231d3cbb9.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n68231d3cbb9.x: Vajra Prahar involves Special Forces; Yudh Abhyas is Army, Cope India is Air Force and Tiger Triumph is tri-service amphibious.

n210fe341e04.s: Mission 500, announced in the February 2025 Modi-Trump joint statement, aims to take India-US trade to $500 billion by:
n210fe341e04.x: Mission 500 aims to double India-US bilateral trade to $500 billion by 2030.

n935d1c2cd91.s: India-US relations are officially described as a:
n935d1c2cd91.x: India-US ties are described as a Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership.

nd211f007cb2.s: Which country has the world's largest Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) community?
nd211f007cb2.x: The United States has the largest PIO community; Malaysia is second.

neaaa73a5018.x: India and Japan have a Special Strategic and Global Partnership.

nebd5f670b9b.s: With the FTA concluded at the 16th India-EU Summit (2026), the EU became India's ____ FTA partner.
nebd5f670b9b.x: The FTA concluded at the 16th Summit made the EU India's 22nd FTA partner; a Security and Defence Partnership was also signed.

n1e1656ff4db.s: The India-Oman CEPA, signed in December 2025, entered into force on:
n1e1656ff4db.x: The CEPA entered into force on 1 June 2026, with Oman giving 99% duty-free access to Indian exports.

nec92f81a823.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nec92f81a823.x: The India-Russia S-400 deal dates to 2018. BrahMos is an India-Russia venture, Kudankulam is in Tamil Nadu and Kovvada is in Andhra Pradesh.

n46562871ed4.s: In the April 2024 UNSC vote on full UN membership for Palestine, which country used its veto?
n46562871ed4.x: The United States vetoed the proposal, while the United Kingdom and Switzerland abstained.

n2a66795b525.s: An amendment to the UN Charter, such as one for UNSC reform, requires:
o: A two-thirds majority of members, including ratification by all five permanent members
A simple majority of members, including all five permanent members
A two-thirds majority of members, without needing the permanent members
Unanimous approval of all UN members
n2a66795b525.x: A Charter amendment needs a two-thirds majority of members and ratification by all five permanent members of the Security Council.

n89be88978f7.s: In the Kulbhushan Jadhav case (2019), the ICJ held that Pakistan had breached the:
n89be88978f7.x: The ICJ held that Pakistan breached the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations and ordered a review of Jadhav's conviction.

n478528dc174.s: Sarnath was inscribed as India's 45th World Heritage Site in July 2026 at the World Heritage Committee session held in:
n478528dc174.x: Sarnath was inscribed at the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee in Busan, South Korea, in July 2026.

n99dbb1eb5d1.s: The Hoysala temples of Karnataka were inscribed on the World Heritage List in:
n99dbb1eb5d1.x: The Hoysala temples were inscribed in September 2023.

n4efe21feb1a.s:
Consider the following statements about UNESCO:
1. It runs the Man and the Biosphere Programme.
2. It leads SDG-4 on Education 2030.
3. It compiles the Global Multidimensional Poverty Index.
Which of the above is/are correct?
n4efe21feb1a.x: UNESCO runs the Man and the Biosphere Programme and leads SDG-4; the Global MPI is built by UNDP and OPHI.

n670a1c81247.s: According to the Emissions Gap Report 2025, current policies put the world on course for warming of about:
n670a1c81247.x: The report projects about 2.8°C under current policies and 2.3-2.5°C if NDCs are fully implemented.

n30d55ace01e.s: The International Trade Organization proposed at Bretton Woods was never created. Which arrangement filled the gap from 1947 until 1995?
n30d55ace01e.x: The ITO was not created; GATT filled the gap from 1947 until the WTO was set up in 1995.

o: Emergency loans repayable within a year
n2991af6fc88.x: World Bank loans are generally medium- and long-term in nature.

nc8d632d8940.s: The New Development Bank froze Russia-linked operations in March 2022. What was Russia's shareholding in the Bank?
nc8d632d8940.x: Russia was a 20% shareholder of the NDB, which froze Russia-linked operations in March 2022.

ndd7a905fe2f.s: Who became President of the World Bank in June 2023?
ndd7a905fe2f.x: Ajay Banga has been World Bank President since June 2023; K.V. Kamath was the first NDB President.

n31a11f6ad47.s: Which of the following is NOT an IMF lending facility?
n31a11f6ad47.x: Stand-By Arrangement, Extended Fund Facility and Rapid Financing Instrument are IMF facilities; political-risk guarantees are associated with MIGA.

nc83dce038c9.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: IBRD – Loans to middle-income governments for infrastructure
nc83dce038c9.x: The IBRD lends to middle-income governments for infrastructure; MIGA gives political-risk insurance and ICSID settles investment disputes.

n1efa101f222.s: The International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID), of which India is not a member, mainly:
o: Insures foreign investors against political risk
Gives interest-free credits to the poorest countries
n1efa101f222.x: ICSID settles investment disputes, and India is not a member.

naaa3183e952.s: Which country is the second-largest shareholder of the Beijing-based Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank?
naaa3183e952.x: China is the largest shareholder of the AIIB and India the second-largest.

n778f8aef05b.s: The New Development Bank is headquartered at:
n778f8aef05b.x: The NDB is headquartered in Shanghai, with regional offices in Johannesburg, Sao Paulo, GIFT City and Moscow.

n2d537e10422.s:
Assertion (A): Developing countries can obtain bargaining space in WTO negotiations.
Reason (R): The WTO follows a one-country-one-vote principle.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n2d537e10422.x: Both are true, and the one-country-one-vote principle explains the bargaining space developing countries get.

n386f4219693.s: The Dunkel Draft (1991), prepared under Arthur Dunkel, belonged to which round of trade negotiations?
n386f4219693.x: The Dunkel Draft of 1991, associated with Arthur Dunkel, was part of the Uruguay Round.

n0615f17a3b9.s: India's core demand in the WTO food-security negotiations is a permanent solution for:
n0615f17a3b9.x: India's core food-security demand is a permanent solution for public stockholding (PSH).

n8d176c522e1.s: Section 3(d) of India's Patents Act, used as a TRIPS flexibility, is aimed against:
n8d176c522e1.x: India used Section 3(d) against evergreening, along with compulsory licensing, as TRIPS flexibilities for public health.

n9832718fde1.s: BIMSTEC, set up through the 1997 Bangkok Declaration, has its Secretariat at:
n9832718fde1.x: BIMSTEC originated through the 1997 Bangkok Declaration and its Secretariat is in Dhaka.

n7cfe48dc464.s: Which country was expelled from the Council of Europe in March 2022?
n7cfe48dc464.x: Russia was expelled from the Council of Europe, which had 47 members in 2019, in March 2022.

n9240bb0797c.s: India became a summit-level partner of ASEAN in:
n9240bb0797c.x: India became a sectoral partner in 1992, full dialogue partner in 1996, summit-level partner in 2002 and Comprehensive Strategic Partner in 2022.

n97de81bf6b8.s: The East Asia Summit, founded at Kuala Lumpur in 2005, has how many members?
n97de81bf6b8.x: The EAS has 19 members: 11 ASEAN states plus India, China, Japan, the US, Russia, Australia, New Zealand and South Korea.

n7e460d7e1c1.s: NACIN Palasamudram in Rayalaseema serves as a regional training centre of the:
o: UN Office on Drugs and Crime
n7e460d7e1c1.x: NACIN Palasamudram is a World Customs Organization regional training centre for tax officials from SAARC, ASEAN and African nations.

nf8f75cbcc76.s: Indonesia, which joined BRICS in 2025, is also a member of:
nf8f75cbcc76.x: Indonesia is a member of BRICS (2025) and MIKTA, but not of the Quad or IBSA.

n0cf76f63911.s: What is India's position on de-dollarisation in the context of BRICS?
o: India backs an immediate common BRICS currency
India has made de-dollarisation a core foreign-policy aim
India has left BRICS over de-dollarisation
n0cf76f63911.x: India avoids de-dollarisation even while participating in BRICS.

na3d7c730c37.s: The first Quad leaders' summit, in March 2021, was held:
na3d7c730c37.x: The first Quad leaders' summit was virtual (March 2021); the first in-person summit was in Washington in September 2021.

na506496c62b.s: In climate negotiations, the BASIC grouping upholds the principle of:
o: Uniform emission cuts for all countries
Common but Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities (CBDR-RC)
Exclusive reliance on private climate finance
Carbon border taxes on developing countries
na506496c62b.x: BASIC stands for CBDR-RC and climate finance from developed countries.

ne22ad7d3667.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Wassenaar Arrangement – Chemical and biological weapon precursors
Australia Group – Conventional arms and dual-use goods
Hague Code of Conduct – Transparency on ballistic-missile proliferation
ne22ad7d3667.x: The Hague Code of Conduct (2002) concerns ballistic-missile transparency; Wassenaar covers conventional arms and dual-use goods and the Australia Group covers chemical and biological precursors.

n082e244d1df.s: India, which has not signed the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons (TPNW), holds that the treaty:
o: Is backed by all nuclear-armed states
Adds nothing to customary international law
n082e244d1df.x: India did not sign the TPNW and has stated that it adds nothing to customary international law.

neb06cfe8716.s: The Biological Weapons Convention, adopted in 1972 and to which India is a party, entered into force in:
neb06cfe8716.x: The BWC was adopted in 1972, entered into force in 1975 and has no verification organisation.

n349bc73708d.s: Which of the following pairs (nuclear-weapon-free-zone treaty – region) is correctly matched?
n349bc73708d.x: Rarotonga covers the South Pacific; Tlatelolco covers Latin America, Bangkok Southeast Asia and Pelindaba Africa.

n5152cbf1925.s: The Pravasi Bharatiya Samman, the highest honour for overseas Indians, is conferred at Pravasi Bharatiya Divas by the:
n5152cbf1925.x: The Pravasi Bharatiya Samman is conferred by the President at Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.

n7751ede9d79.s: The Leiden Plates, 21 copper plates from the time of Rajaraja Chola I, were returned to India by:
n7751ede9d79.x: The Netherlands returned the Leiden Plates, 21 Chola copper plates of Rajaraja Chola I's time.

n97ba5996e28.s: The Malabar naval exercise began in 1992 as a bilateral exercise between India and:
n97ba5996e28.x: Malabar began as an India-US exercise in 1992; Japan became permanent in 2015 and Australia joined in 2020.

n4ea1b2f6865.s: Samudrayaan, concerned with deep-sea mining and the study of polymetallic nodules, is a component of:
n4ea1b2f6865.x: Samudrayaan is part of India's Deep Ocean Mission and concerns deep-sea mining and polymetallic nodules.

n76d01342745.s:
Consider the following pairs (Force – Year raised):
1. Border Security Force – 1962
2. Coast Guard – 1977
3. Assam Rifles – 1835
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
n76d01342745.x: The Coast Guard was raised in 1977 and Assam Rifles in 1835; the BSF was raised in 1965, not 1962.

nab46d802251.s:
Consider the following pairs (Group – Base):
1. ULFA – Assam
2. NSCN – Nagaland
3. People's War Group – Andhra Pradesh
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
nab46d802251.x: All three are correct: ULFA is based in Assam, NSCN in Nagaland and the People's War Group in Andhra Pradesh.

nb2bab4e397c.s: The Comprehensive Integrated Border Management System (CIBMS), a technology-based smart-fencing system, is meant mainly for India's borders with:
nb2bab4e397c.x: CIBMS is a technology-based smart-fencing system for the Pakistan and Bangladesh borders.

nfa2d2763826.s: Withdrawal of general consent for the CBI and the wider reach of the NIA and BSF are criticised as intruding into which State subjects?
nfa2d2763826.x: The criticism is that these moves enter the State subjects of police and public order.

nc48fd36b08d.s: Which section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, which replaced the IPC from 1 July 2024, defines a terrorist act?
nc48fd36b08d.x: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaced the IPC from 1 July 2024, and its Section 113 defines a terrorist act.

n0cc09cee4c3.s: Which agency filed a chargesheet against Hafiz Saeed?
n0cc09cee4c3.x: The National Investigation Agency filed the chargesheet against Hafiz Saeed.

n40fe6955068.s: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, about 1.5 lakh upgraded Health and Wellness Centres, provide:
n40fe6955068.x: Ayushman Arogya Mandir aims to provide comprehensive primary care through about 1.5 lakh upgraded Health and Wellness Centres.

nindian-society-39-10.s:
Consider the following statements about the Vibrant Villages Programme:
1. It is a grassroots development campaign.
2. It provides reverse-migration incentives in northern border villages.
Which of the above is/are correct?
nindian-society-39-10.x: Both are true: it is a grassroots development campaign offering reverse-migration incentives in northern border villages.

n44293696da6.s: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides health cover of how much per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation?
n44293696da6.x: PM-JAY provides ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.

na3ce837aeeb.s: Ayushman Bharat targets poor and vulnerable populations in:
na3ce837aeeb.x: Ayushman Bharat targets poor and vulnerable populations in both rural and urban areas.

nc35420643dd.s: The general Centre-State funding ratio of PM-JAY is:
nc35420643dd.x: PM-JAY is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme funded 60:40, rising to 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States.

n560e789ffa2.s: PM-JAY originally targeted the bottom ____ of households, about 10.74 crore families.
n560e789ffa2.x: PM-JAY targets the bottom 40 per cent of households, about 10.74 crore poor and deprived families.

n105f8465856.s: Operation Blackboard (1987), launched under the National Policy on Education 1986, aimed at providing:
o: Free online courses for secondary students
n105f8465856.x: Operation Blackboard provided minimum facilities in primary schools, especially in educationally backward areas.

nindian-society-39-15.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao – Border areas
Accessible India Campaign – Persons with Disabilities
Vibrant Villages Programme – Youth substance abuse
Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan – Women and child
nindian-society-39-15.x: Accessible India targets persons with disabilities; BBBP is about women and children, Vibrant Villages about border areas and Nasha Mukt Bharat about youth substance abuse.

nc928838f2d9.s:
Consider the following pairs (Programme – Associated body):
1. PM-JAY – National Health Authority
2. NAMASTE – Ministry of Education
3. Jal Jeevan Mission – Ministry of Jal Shakti
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
nc928838f2d9.x: PM-JAY (NHA) and Jal Jeevan Mission (Jal Shakti) are correct; NAMASTE is with the Ministries of Social Justice and Housing and Urban Affairs, not Education.

nindian-society-39-16.s: Which of the following pairs (Programme – Implementing ministry) is correctly matched?
o: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao – Ministry of Home Affairs
Poshan Maah – Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Vibrant Villages Programme – Ministry of Home Affairs
Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan – Ministry of Women and Child Development
nindian-society-39-16.x: Vibrant Villages is run by the Home Ministry; BBBP is joint (MoWCD, MoHFW, MoE), Poshan campaigns are under WCD and Nasha Mukt Bharat under Social Justice.

ncdc31379f2d.s: Under IGNWPS and IGNDPS, the central assistance for beneficiaries aged 80 years and above is:
ncdc31379f2d.x: Both schemes give ₹300 for the lower age group and ₹500 for beneficiaries aged 80 or above.

n8c175fa9356.s: Social assistance differs from social insurance in that social assistance is:
n8c175fa9356.x: Social assistance is non-contributory, tax-funded and means-tested, while social insurance is contributory and tied to employment and risks.

n976fa78921e.s: Under the ESI scheme (wage ceiling ₹21,000 a month), the employer's and employee's contributions are respectively:
n976fa78921e.x: The employer contributes 3.25% and the employee 0.75%, with a wage ceiling of ₹21,000 per month.

nc7c37a1a436.s: The Soil Health Card scheme, giving nutrient status and fertiliser advice for each holding, was launched in 2015 at:
nc7c37a1a436.x: The Soil Health Card scheme was launched in 2015 at Suratgarh in Rajasthan.

nee5c4c6cd49.s: NRLM, restructured from SGSY in 2011, was renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-NRLM in:
nee5c4c6cd49.x: NRLM was restructured from SGSY in 2011 and renamed DAY-NRLM in 2016.

ndc15994fd07.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: VB-G RAM G – 100 days of work per household per year
MGNREGA – 100 days of unskilled manual work per household per year
VB-G RAM G – 75 days of skilled work per household per year
MGNREGA – 125 days of work per household per year
ndc15994fd07.x: MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days of unskilled manual work per household per year; VB-G RAM G provides a 125-day guarantee.

nadd2abf7cd0.s: The general Centre-State funding pattern for Centrally Sponsored Schemes is:
nadd2abf7cd0.x: The general pattern is 60:40, with 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and full central funding for UTs without legislatures.

nbd42835ac67.s: PM SVANidhi provides working-capital loans, starting at ₹10,000, to:
nbd42835ac67.x: PM SVANidhi supports street vendors with a first loan of ₹10,000, a 7 per cent interest subsidy and digital cashback.

nba0a10964f8.s: SANKALP, the MSDE programme to strengthen district-level skilling institutions, is supported by the:
nba0a10964f8.x: SANKALP is a World Bank-supported MSDE programme for district-level skilling institutions.

na5fc272e599.s: Which Ministry of Rural Development skilling programme is placement-linked for rural youth?
na5fc272e599.x: DDU-GKY is placement-linked for rural youth, while RSETIs focus on self-employment.

nindian-society-38-25.s: The MY Bharat portal comes under which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
nindian-society-38-25.x: The MY Bharat portal is under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
